Steve joined Jammin DJ’s inc Denver’s Premier DJ Company in 2007. He has had the honor of hosting several weddings and corporate events for the company. Steve has received great reviews from clients and is well known for providing a night full of entertainment for any crowd.

Steve has been in the entertainment industry for over 15 years. He started his Disc Jockey career at the age of 13 working for his local skating rink and has progressed to being the host at several different events including having the honor of hosting the (VIP) Tailgate Parties for the Denver Broncos. Steve has had experience in many facets of being a Disc Jockey such as in clubs, local musician amphitheater events and being a spokesperson for The Memphis Area Band Association. Steve also has had the pleasure of being a sound engineer for local musicians and the host for their entertainment events .Steve was personally a live performer as a musician entertaining venues such as The Hard Rock Cafe, The Budweiser Pavilion, and The New Daisy Theater on Beale Street in Memphis, TN where he is from. He has hosted, on several occasions talent shows in Memphis for 94.7 “The Buzz” and 92.9 “93x” two of Memphis’s hottest radio stations.

Steve also works during the day building customized websites and ecommerce shopping carts for the largest design and development firm in Colorado www.madwirewebdesign.com .
